required.reason: Pinned-WPT-derived contract for the restricted cross-origin WindowProxy surface, stable browsing-context identity, Location navigation and repeated same-origin/opaque commits.

excluded.reason: The upstream matrix depends on multiple hosted origins, popup creation and broad Window/Location descriptors. This contract isolates nested contexts and the operations implemented by the native frame navigation path.
The upstream WindowProxy suite covers top-level auxiliary browsing contexts. This contract retains its stable identity boundary across nested origin transitions.
